traits.capitulum_kind.note: FNA's account of the genus: each head has a ring of pistillate ray florets round its bisexual disc florets.

traits.receptacle.note: FNA's account of the genus: the receptacle, flat to slightly convex (rarely conic), bears thin, often folded chaffy scales (paleae) among the florets.

traits.pappus.note: OregonFlora's key to the genus: the flattened, somewhat winged fruits bear no pappus.
